header: A measured result, and what produced it
lead: The figure large, its unit beside it, one line of explanation underneath. The explanation is the point: it names the capability behind the number.
note: Where the figures are properties to look up rather than wins to celebrate, the spec sheet is the honest band.

metrics.title: Entries per band
metrics.text: Beyond six the figures stop being memorable and become a table.

metrics.title: Tabular numerals
metrics.text: So the figures across a row line up on the digit rather than on the font's glyph widths.

metrics.title: The capability behind it
metrics.text: This line is what separates the band from a plain statistics strip.
